name: Rushing Elbowbend
description: Set the throwing plane level with the shoulder and fix where the circle of the stick will close.

name: Doughty Crookend
description: Release while a thread of qi runs down the arm into the stick so its first spin is already fast.

name: Pirouetting Returnarc
description: Sidle two steps along the stick's shadow on the ground to stand where its circle will end.

name: Kindly Curveback
description: Raise the catching hand to shoulder height and seize the stick the moment its spin slackens.

name: Shielding Wingarm
description: Pull the stick back close and turn a cut aside with its thick wing before the next cast.

name: Raw Arc
description: Throw a full circle that passes the target's shoulder outbound and strikes its back on the return.

name: Return Carapace
description: Send the looping stick past an opponent's guard so its return snaps the weapon hand open.

name: Kindly Sweptwing
description: Squint along the wing arm to judge how sharply the stick will lean when canted.

name: Rude Leadingedge
description: Pull the arm across the chest as the stick leaves so its cant is set by the release alone.

name: Curveswat
description: Hold the low wing toward the ground and keep qi on it so the stick curls along the earth.

name: Circling Glide
description: Pace along the inside of the stick's curve to keep the line of the throw within sight.

name: Fleet Cycle
description: Stoop and pivot on the ball of one foot to slip a thrust while the stick is still away.

name: Layered Trailingedge
description: Slide a cut down the length of the wing edge and off the hand with a short push of qi.

name: Wild Woodgrain
description: Cant the stick one way and then feed qi to bend it back so it curves twice around cover.

name: Stern Tipwing
description: Hold qi steady in one wing so the stick curls around a post or a pillar and finds the target behind it.

name: Woodflog
description: Wind the arm in a slow double circle to store the rhythm for a throw that crosses the mark twice.

name: Hearty Sweptwing
description: Take the returning stick in the throwing palm already set for the next cast.

name: Grainzip
description: Reset the feet with one short hop after a catch so the stance is square for the next throw.

name: Barkbarrier
description: Rap an opponent's blade hand with the stick's heavy arm and drive it wide.

name: Rude Wingarm
description: Throw so the stick strikes on the outward leg and again as it passes the target on the way home.

name: Barkhasp
description: Send two sticks on crossing paths so an opponent cannot guard both and breaks stance.

name: Staticwood
description: Seat qi in the thumb and finger so the pinch on the wing never loosens before release.

name: Shard Cycle
description: Hold a small knot of qi at the elbow of the stick so the whole body spins around it evenly.

name: Dire Elbowbend
description: Snap the wrist with a pulse of qi so the spin starts hard and does not need to build.

name: Gapwood
description: Stand with the head cocked and listen to the stick's hum to tell if its spin is holding.

name: Hoverswerve
description: Step backward and take the spinning stick from the air with a hand wrapped in soft qi.

name: Stubborn Curveback
description: Whirl the held stick in front of the body to knock small missiles off their line.

name: Ember Tipwing
description: Throw a stick so fast that its spinning wings cut through light cloth and leather on the pass.

name: Cruel Hover
description: Keep the stick humming round an opponent's head so they dare not raise their eyes or advance.

name: Brawn Arc
description: Catch the spinning stick on the palm side and drag its edge across an opponent's bared forearm.

name: Static Leadingedge
description: Rap the target's knuckles with the stick held at a slant from the hand.

name: Loopback Thwack
description: Drive the thick elbow of the stick into the ribs of a foe who has closed in.

name: Static Circling
description: Slide the hand up toward the elbow so the long wing swings as a quick short club.

name: Cyclescorer
description: Stab the thin wing tip forward at an opponent's eyes or throat to make them flinch.

name: Rill Loopback
description: Pivot the body to follow the swinging stick so the strike keeps its reach and balance.

name: Sprig Crookend
description: Cross the stick over forearm and chest to block a sweeping blow with its full length.

name: Static Hover
description: Give ground one step and cast the stick at the pursuer in the same breath.

name: Grainprop
description: Hook the crook of the stick behind an opponent's knee or wrist and haul them off balance.

name: Wild Elbowbend
description: Chop down through a guard with the qi-sharpened wing edge and split the defender's grip on the haft.

name: Clay Trailingedge
description: Sweep the stick in a wide backhand arc to drive a ring of attackers back a pace.

name: Recall Woodgrain
description: Hold the receiving hand open and low at the hip and let the eye follow the stick.

name: Candorcurve
description: Snatch a fast-flying stick from the air with a quick flick of the fingers and a puff of qi.

name: Stout Wingarm
description: Squeeze the spinning wing so the rotation dies in the palm and the stick is still.

name: Brawn Circling
description: Slide the lead foot half a step to square the body after a long reaching catch.

name: Cometwood
description: Take the stick and throw it again before the wrist has settled so the rhythm never drops.

name: Emberbark
description: Catch and re-throw the stick in a chain so a target meets a fresh cast every moment.

name: Static Return
description: Catch a thrown stone or a dart out of the air and throw the same back at the sender.

name: Honedarc
description: Shift the hand from the throwing pinch to the clubbing hold of the stick in one turn.

name: Scudding Trailingedge
description: Cast the stick and run in behind it so you arrive as the opponent is struck.

name: Hum Leadingedge
description: Hold the flat of the stick beside the ribs and turn a low thrust off the body.

name: Brass Curveback
description: Drive the elbow of the stick forward like a short pick into the soft spot under the ribs.

name: Grainswerve
description: Circle the opponent so the returning stick comes toward you across their back.

name: Shard Hover
description: Cast a short low throw to draw the guard down and then club high on the return.

name: Barkprop
description: Turn a blow with the held stick and let the same motion carry the cast into the opening.

name: Sprig Return
description: Wedge the stick through a foe's weapon and sleeve and twist so the arm is pinned fast.

name: Recall Returnarc
description: Pick the wall or tree or rock whose angle will turn the stick toward the mark.

name: Cycle Swat
description: Throw at a shallow angle across the chosen surface so the stick skips off it cleanly.

name: Curveswerve
description: Plant the heel and turn the toe until the body points at the bounce and not the target.

name: Shardcurve
description: Catch a stick that has struck stone with the palm cushioned by a thin layer of qi.

name: Raw Woodgrain
description: Cast the stick off a wall and have it carry a crescent path into a foe behind cover.

name: Swift Sweptwing
description: Bounce the stick off two surfaces in a row to strike a mark that has no clear line.
